title: Day Trading Model is up 13% in 20 days
author: Must_Dragonfruit
selftext:

comments.author: Tight_Papaya_2164
comments.body:
Genuinely interesting build, but there's a measurement problem worth fixing before you spend more.

The forward number can't yet say anything. SE on an annualized Sharpe is ≈ √(252/n). At 29 daily obs that's 2.95, so your 1.52 is 0.5 SE from zero — not evidence in either direction. Getting to t=2 at a true Sharpe of 1.52 takes \~440 trading days.

And the bar is stricter than that, because 12 names × 8% long-only is beta≈1. "Beta-neutralized" is describing your signal (residual of a beta regression), not your book. So the real claim is an IR vs SPY, not a Sharpe: at \~9% tracking error and 6%/yr excess that's IR 0.65 → \~9-11 years to significance. Beta-hedging at the portfolio level (short SPY against it) doesn't add return, it buys you \~5× the statistical power. Cheapest change available.

With 32 models plus agents spawning subagents, the null isn't Sharpe > 0, it's Sharpe > best-of-N. Expected max Sharpe under a pure null with a 3yr OOS window: 1.21 at N=32, 1.60 at N=200. Your 1.52 sits inside that range. That's not a verdict — it's just that you hout N, and unlogged subagents make Nuncountable. Log every trial any agent generates, pass or fail. (Correlated variants lower the effective N and the bar, which helps you — but you still have three cheap tests that would actually move

1. Rebalance-frequency invariance. A real 20-day signal should hold its Sharpe from daily → weekly with a buffer band. If it collapses, the edge is 1-day mve live fills. Costs you an afternoon and can settle it outright.

2. Regress backtest daily returns on FF5 + is 40% IT / 24% healthcare / zerofinancials, industrials, staples, utilities, REITs. Twelve names cannot separate stock selection from sector allocation — if alpha to factors+sectors h tilt, not an edge.

3. You already own a null distribution. Plot the Sharpe distribution across all 32 models. If it's centered near zero with the spread the sample size predire the max order statistic should, that'syour answer for free. A right tail beyond that would be the real signal.

One consistency check: if you started at $100k, $113,381 in 29 days is +13.4%, which annualizes to \~198%. A Sharpe of 1.52 alongside that implies \~130% annuaga-cap book does not have. At a realistic18-22% vol, SR 1.52 predicts +3-4% over 29 days. So either the start capital wasn't $100k, or the 1.52 is your backtest number and the live run is a betaape. Worth pinning down — they're differentclaims.

Minor: a 20-day formation is the classic short-term reversal window (Jegadeesh 1990); residual momentum (Blitz–Huij–Martens 2011) is 12-1 month. N a small/illiquid-cap effect — but you'reclaiming a sign flip at that horizon, which raises the evidentiary bar rather than lowering it.

replies.author: Tight_Papaya_2164
replies.body:
Danke dir. Mein Schwerpunkt liegt tatsächlich eher auf der technischen Seite – also auf dem Aufbau, Testen und Analysieren algorithmischer Trading-Systeme – kombiniert mit einem starken Interesse an den zugrunde liegenden Finanzmärkten.  
Ich entwickle meine Systeme größtenteils selbst und beschäftige mich viel mit Python, Backtesting, Statistik, Datenanalyse, Signalentwicklung und der Frage, ob ein vermeintlicher Edge tatsächlich belastbar ist oder nur ein Artefakt der Daten.  
Ich mache inzwischen auch **Freelance-Arbeiten gegen Bezahlung**. Falls du irgendwann Unterstützung bei Python, Trading-Systemen, Datenanalyse, Automatisierung, Backtesting oder ähnlichen technischen Projekten brauchst, kannst du dich gerne bei mir melden.
